title: Momoi Airi — We're Matching♥〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Early morning
Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, we're done with our New Year's shrine visit!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! We're gonna work harder and harder and harder this year to make our dream of doing a show at the Dome a reality!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's what I like to hear.
Now, let's go see how lucky we are by drawing ourselves some fortunes!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Come to think of it, we chose this shrine because it enshrines a deity of the performing arts, but they also have cute fortunes, right?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm also looking forward to what their fortunes look like.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Instead of telling you, it'll be quicker to just see for yourselves. The shrine office should be... Oh, over there!
se_walk_women_001_4

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes! These are the flower fortunes that they only have during New Year's!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! The shelves are all covered in different types of flowers!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But they're not real. They're all made of paper, yes?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, using washi paper.
The actual fortune is apparently tied to the flower's stem.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, that's interesting.
Then, does that mean we should choose our favorite flowers?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, look!
The shelves for these flowers all have numbers written on them!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just tell the shrine maiden which number you'd like and she'll bring over your flower.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Also, these aren't the only flower fortunes this place has to offer. Look to your right!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, those fortunes are all shaped like cherry-blossom petals!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right! Each petal is designed to be unfolded, which then reveals your fortune.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Interesting. And it turns into a cherry blossom once it's fully bloomed, so to speak.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Cool!
Those also seem really cute!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know, right? We made plans to draw fortunes together, so I thought we could create some fun memories for ourselves.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I really need to thank Ena again for telling me about these fantastically photogenic fortunes.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Let's go over and ask once we've all made our choices.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You still seemed undecided until a second ago, Minori, but you decided to go with the flower petal type, the same as Shizuku?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yup! I thought this one would suit my room the best!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm very much looking forward to seeing what my fortune says.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me too. Let's all open them together.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Ready, everyone?
One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, I got a blessing.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Mine is a small blessing.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Same here...
I'm not sure how to feel about this.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: B-B-B-B-Bad luck?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh dear...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, that's perfect!
That's the best result we could ask for, TV-wise.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
The best?! Far from it!
And we're not doing a shoot right now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm gonna go get another one!
se_run_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Seriously, she doesn't see how that's variety-show gold?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At the same time, I'm not happy with my fortune either. So, I'm also gonna draw another one. I want a great blessing or absolutely terrible luck!
se_run_women_001_2

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I understand wanting a great blessing, but I don't think I've ever heard someone say that they want terrible luck with such exuberance...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, but we also shouldn't expect anything else from Airi.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Minori Hanasato will now be making her second drawing! Please!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Great blessing or terrible luck! Great blessing or terrible luck!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Bad luck...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
This is actually terrible.
Getting a worse fortune is one thing, but it's not really funny if I have the same bad luck as you, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If anything, it would've been better if I drew another small blessing. That seems way more unlikely, so it would at least be funny—

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Nooooooo!
Wh-Why does it keep giving me bad luck?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: M-Minori...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, the year's just started, but you're already on fire! Not many people get two of those in a row!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do you mean I'm on fire?! This is terrible!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, it's not! You've even been providing us with top-notch reactions! But I'm not about to let you hog the spotlight!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
My small blessing was followed by bad luck...
Normally, I'd draw one more and hope for a positive.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But nothing will do right now other than terrible luck!
se_run_women_001_3

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Excuse me! Can I draw another fortune?!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Us drawing fortunes has suddenly turned into practicing for our next appearance on a variety show...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: All this activity must've woken Airi's inner variety-show spirit from its slumber.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I-I'm also not leaving here with just bad luck!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Wait for me, Airi!
I also wanna draw another one!
se_run_women_001_1
